evals.prompt: I cloned xboxrecomp and extracted default.xbe from my ISO into game_files/. Walk me through the exact commands to run the Python pipeline and what files I should expect in each output folder.
evals.expected_output: Ordered list of py -3 -m tools.* commands (xbe_parser, disasm --text-only, func_id, recomp --all --split 1000) with output paths (functions.json, gen/recomp_*.c, etc.) and prerequisite pip install capstone.
expectations: Response includes pip install capstone or capstone prerequisite
Response includes tools.recomp with --all and mentions gen/recomp output files
Response documents xbe_parser script fallback (xbe_parser.py) or verifies __main__.py exists

evals.prompt: My recompiled Xbox game crashes immediately with 'ICALL FAIL: VA=0x1C45BA68'. I have a MAP file. How do I find which recompiled function made the bad call and what should I try first to fix it?
evals.expected_output: Steps to map caller address via .map file, interpret garbage VA vs valid Xbox VA, use g_icall_trace, add recomp_manual.c override or dispatch entry, reference indirect-calls.md workflow.
expectations: Response explains using the MAP file to map native caller address to a recompiled symbol
Response names recomp_manual.c and recomp_lookup_manual as the override location
Response mentions g_icall_trace or ICALL trace ring buffer
Response treats 0x1C45BA68 as garbage vtable per indirect-calls.md and recommends range guard before dispatch

evals.prompt: I want to start a new OG Xbox static recomp project for a RenderWare game. What CMake/template layout should I use from xboxrecomp and which runtime libraries do I link?
evals.expected_output: Point to templates/new-game/, XBOXRECOMP_DIR + add_subdirectory, link xboxrecomp umbrella, list six libs purpose, mention recomp_manual.c and templates/runtime headers.
expectations: Response mentions XBOXRECOMP_DIR or add_subdirectory for xboxrecomp
Response names all six runtime libraries or states xboxrecomp umbrella links them
Response notes RenderWare has no separate link library and func_id RW classification applies
